export.fidelity_note: All bibliographic fields (entry type, citation key, title, author, journal/booktitle, volume, number, pages, year, month, DOI, URL, ISSN, abstract, keywords, language, publisher, copyright, note) are as returned by Zotero. Two presentational normalizations were applied to non-bibliographic metadata: (1) 'file' attachment paths are written in Zotero's canonical escaped form (drive colon as '\:', path separators as '\\'); (2) the LaTeX inside three 'annote' note fields was re-encoded into readable LaTeX instead of Zotero's double-escaped transport form. No citation key, DOI, title, or record was altered, added, or dropped.
